criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official page documents image-to-video input, but no AIVP run verifies exact product identity or first-10-second distinctiveness.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Vendor samples and claims are not hands-on AIVP evidence.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: No repeatability, seed, camera-control or product-drift evidence was retrieved.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Text-to-video and image-to-video via a claimed fal route are documented; the linked endpoint could not be independently retrieved and no end-to-end export was run.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Claims of seconds-level generation are unverified; no queue, render or failure artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Official page advertises about US$0.01 per generated second, but also contains launch-copy inconsistencies and no provider invoice or AIVP run confirms the rate.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Creatify terms grant compliant users limited commercial use of Community Assets; Boreal-on-fal output ownership, input treatment and complete monetized-video rights still require confirmation.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Vendor says Boreal is available on fal, implying an API route; exact endpoint/schema and production accessibility were not retrieved.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Low-cost browser/API generation is relevant to AU creators, but Australia-specific access, billing and tax treatment are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: AIVP already has verified active Creatify affiliate tracking; the official programme advertises 25% recurring commission.

analysis: Boreal is a commercially interesting low-cost LTX-derived text/image-to-video model, but the launch is late-discovered, the fal endpoint was not independently retrievable, and every outcome criterion remains untested.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor pages and terms only; no AIVP hands-on run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Not approved until all three runs preserve exact LED-mask identity in the first 10 seconds.
hard_gates.publication: First Look draft only; Boreal/fal rights and availability require confirmation.
hard_gates.integration: Not started; fal endpoint and no-cost allowance not verified.
